name: athach

attributes.attribute: Scottish monster that haunted the Highlands
killed passersby and threw them into gorges
female athach, the luideag of Skye
male athach of Glen Etive with one hand from the chest and one eye in the forehead

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The athach is a Scottish monster. It haunted the Scottish Highlands and killed passersby, throwing them into gorges or down rocky hills. The athach appeared in variants. The female luideag haunted of Skye. The male díreach of Glen Étow, with one hand growing from his chest and one eye in his forehead, haunted the Glen Etive. The figure connects to the Fachan.
objective: Establish the athach as a Scottish monster with male and female variants.
key_results: The athach haunted the Scottish Highlands.
The female luadech was of Skye.
The male díreach of Glen Etive had one hand from the chest and one eye in the forehead.
The athach is linked to the Fachan.
